Create a token: open Developer settings, then Personal access tokens > Fine-grained tokens, and choose Generate new token. Upload permissions: Contents = Read and write and Metadata = Read-only. For new repositories use Administration = Read and write. Add Workflows = Read and write if the app will modify GitHub Actions files. Limit the token to the repositories it needs, then paste it into the app. Never share it; you can revoke it from GitHub. Smart upload compares Git SHAs with GitHub, so unchanged files are not uploaded again. If the connection drops, the app keeps the ZIP and retries automatically when the connection returns, reusing blobs already uploaded. You can cancel at any time. Cancelling stops the upload and keeps the temporary ZIP for safe cleanup or resume handling. ZIP is the only upload source. You can send a ZIP directly to the app from your file manager share menu. Changed files are uploaded in parallel for better speed on large projects, while the ZIP is processed in bounded batches to reduce memory use. Auto-naming uses the ZIP filename as the new repository name and can be enabled or disabled in Settings. Download saves a ZIP copy of the selected repository branch.
